note: service sonarr: container_name is ignored: the instance is named for the service, which is the name siblings use
note: service sonarr: bind mount /path/to/sonarr/data is mounted as it is: files owned by a host user show up as "nobody" in the container, so the app can read it but probably not write to it. Add :ro if it only reads, or :shift to map the ids (needs idmapped-mount support on that filesystem)

Add :ro if it only reads, or :shift to map the ids (needs idmapped-mount support on that filesystem)
